meta.source: inputs/reference.mp4 (a founder interview film for a rugged laptop made in an American factory)
meta.note: bin/dissect measured 52 shots; its shot 50 holds a low-contrast hard cut at 108.82 (soft-cut candidate 0.07, confirmed on frames: diagonal etch angle -> straight-on etch angle), so it is split here and later shots are renumbered +1. Cuts per minute 27.1. Every transition is a hard cut.

speakers.A: char_founder (the only voice in the film)

acts.name: Cold open: the heritage claim
acts.function: Establish the factory in one symmetrical wide while the founder's first line pre-laps; land him on camera with a national-pride claim in the past tense.

acts.name: Heritage archive
acts.function: Prove the claim with black-and-white 4:3 archive (soldiers, artillery, a room-size computer) under continuous voice-over; no presenter on screen for 12.5 s.

acts.name: The loss
acts.function: Back to the interview rig, alternating three angles: 'Then we gave it away', outsourcing, dependence. Music drops 5 dB.

acts.name: The stakes
acts.function: 'That's insane' reaction, then the conditional thesis split across two cameras (if you don't control X / you can't control Y), then the 80-years-ago bridge.

acts.name: Turn and reveal
acts.function: 'Now we're bringing it home. This is {PRODUCT}.' An arm gesture motivates the cut to the product, lit like jewellery in black, four product angles in 7.4 s.

acts.name: Proof: made here
acts.function: Workers' faces and gloved hands, one 'knows how to' per cut; then the founder demos the product at the bench and a tight close-up says it must survive rough environments.

acts.name: Proof: built for the field
acts.function: Daylight woodland intercut with the founder's bench demo: set down, open, type, carry; modular shells and add-ons explained in one long line.

acts.name: Mission montage
acts.function: Fast macro assembly cuts (~1.2 s each) under the mission voice-over while the music builds to the film's peak; ends on a laptop booting.

acts.name: Payoff: the etch
acts.function: The claim is laser-etched into the product, letter by letter, over two angles, then the full label is revealed; the closing line rides over it.

acts.name: End card
acts.function: Black card, small brand mark, music tail to silence.

look.grade: Low-key industrial documentary. Desaturated cool steel-greys and near-black shadows; the only saturated colours are the cyan-blue ESD bench tops, the founder's warm tropical floral shirt and the product's coyote-tan / bronze finish. Field exteriors are warm, natural late-afternoon daylight. Archive is neutral black-and-white.
look.contrast: High: deep blacks with lifted-but-dark mids; highlights only in strip lights, bench tops, gloves and the laser spark.
look.light: Practical overhead linear LED strips as top light; soft single key on faces from the eyeline side; product shots rim/top lit in black voids; daylight dappled through oaks outside.
look.depth_of_field: Shallow on every close shot (85 mm f/1.8 interview angles, macro hands and product); deep only in the establishing wide and the demo wide.
look.grain: Fine digital texture, no added grain on colour footage; heavy grain, softness and flicker on archive.
look.brightness: Measured 0-255: interview and factory shots sit at 38-53 (CAM_C and CAM_D darkest, 33-40); product-in-black 18-44 (s25 is 18), product hero rises 61-81; assembly 46-76; archive 42-86 (inside a black surround); field daylight 78-111 (s38 brightest at 111); etch 39-49; end card 1.

archive_texture.window: 4:3 window x 22.9-77.0%, y 14.6-85.2% (693 x 508 px at 1280x720; aspect 1.36), the stills s09-s10 slightly narrower (24.1-75.8% x); surround pure black (0)
archive_texture.newsreel_s04_s07: moving B/W film: frame-to-frame brightness flicker std 1.0 level (peak-to-peak 3.6 on the 0-255 scale) - gentle, not strobing; muzzle flashes jump +100 levels for 2-3 frames (s06); animated grain: median frame-to-frame pixel change 2.7-5.5 levels, spatial grain high-pass std ~9-10 levels at 960 px width; gate weave +-1 px at 960 px (0.1% of the width), random each frame
archive_texture.stills_s08_s10: completely frozen: no grain animation, no flicker, no weave, no move (frame difference exactly 0). The texture is the photograph's own coarse print grain baked into the still (high-pass std ~20 levels at 960 px). Do NOT add animated grain or flicker to the stills.

etch_texture.surface: s50: very dark slate (mean 44-47), matte, faint fine micro-scratches running diagonally, sparse 1-3 px white dust specks; static (no animated grain, frame-to-frame brightness std 0.85). Shallow focus band along the text: detail 3x sharper at the text than in the top-right and bottom-left corners, which fall soft. s51: near straight-on, a fine speckle grain inside the focus area (high-pass std ~7 levels, +-2 levels frame to frame), corners darker (38 vs 48) and soft. s52: soft top light, even focus, bottom 40% to black.
etch_texture.letters: etched strokes are pale grey-blue (RGB ~112,129,143 across the stroke, brighter edges to ~185,198,202), frosted, no glow; a stroke is complete the frame after the spark leaves it
etch_texture.spark: white-hot core RGB ~250,252,240 (clipped white at the centre), core 1.1-2.0% of frame width (20-40 px at 1920), small blue-white bloom ~3x the core, core size flickers 2-3x frame to frame. It draws one stroke at a time along the stroke (1-3% of the width per frame), not a left-to-right wipe, and jumps instantly between strokes and words (one frame, up to 20% of the width). In s51 two or three heads are often lit at once on different strokes 3-8% W apart. In s50 a faint warm amber-brown vapour glow (~RGB 120,80,60 at 15-25% opacity) streams up and to the right behind the spark, ~15% W long and 4% H wide, soft, changing shape every frame; in s51 only a faint cool haze. No flying particles, no smoke clouds, no flare streaks. Reference: set/fx_etch_spark.jpg.

sound.music: score.wav: one continuous electronic bed at ~122 BPM under the whole film, never in front of the voice. M0 silence 0-0.49 | M1 heritage bed 0.5-18.6: low sustained synth pad with a soft 122 BPM pulse, fades up from silence by 2 s, steady around -34 LUFS (stem) from 6 s | M2 loss 18.6-33.9: the bed thins and drops 5 dB (-38 to -40 LUFS stem), sparse low drone, almost no pulse | M3 stakes and turn 33.9-53.9: an accent lands at 34.0 (on 'That's insane', stem jumps to -28), steady pulse at -32/-33, swells into the name 48-53 (peak -28 at 52 on the product reveal) | M4 proof 53.9-94.3: steady driving bed at -35/-36 LUFS stem, brighter rhythmic layer (spectral centre ~1 kHz vs ~550 Hz before), unobtrusive under the voice | M5 mission build 94.3-104.2: lifts to -30 at 94-100, builds to the film's peak (-26 at 102, -22 at 104) and crests on the cut into the etch at 104.15 | M6 payoff 104.2-114.3: drops after 106 to -38 under 'birthright', a soft resolve at -35, tails off from 112 | M7 end 114.3-117.3: last tail at -40, silence from 116.68
sound.speech: One voice (the founder), dry and close-miked, always on top, -17 to -20 LUFS momentary while speaking. He talks nearly continuously from 1.74 to 102.40 with only breath gaps (longest 1.4 s at 93.89-95.30, before the mission line), then pauses 4.5 s for the music crest and returns for two closing lines at 106.90-111.65. 34 of 53 shots carry him as voice-over with no presenter on screen (s01, all archive, product, assembly, field and hand inserts); interview shots carry their own sync speech.
sound.mix: Voice and music are each at full master level and the music is NOT ducked: measured on the separated stems in 400 ms windows while he speaks, the voice sits at a median -23.6 dBFS RMS and the music under it at -31.0, so the voice is a median 5.6 dB over the music (10th percentile -5.2 dB: the music is louder at the stakes accent and the crest; 90th +14.3 dB: the drops). Per kept line (voice minus music RMS over the line, measured): L01 +17.6, L04 +4.4, L10 -0.5, L11 -6.7, L13 +6.0, L14 +9.5, L15 +1.0, L21 +1.9, L23 +17.6, L24 +8.3. The music carries the dynamics (drop at 18.6, accent at 34.0, swell at 48-53, build 94-104, drop at 106). No room tone, no ambience, no foley; a barely audible laser sizzle under the etch is the only effect. Silence 0-0.49 and 116.68-117.28. Source loudness -18.0 LUFS integrated, sample peak -0.05 dBFS.

mix_rule.gain: lines 0 dB, score 0 dB (the line clips and score files are cut from the master's own stems, so unity reproduces the source balance). No ducking, no score cut under the lines.
mix_rule.overs: The source master is peak-normalised to -0.05 dBFS with only a light limiter (17 samples above -0.1 dBFS and 419 above -1 dBFS in 117 s). The voice alone peaks at -0.4 dBFS (L24) and -0.5 (L15), so when a cut lays a line over a louder bar than its own, the sum goes over 0 dBFS: cut15 +1.4 dBFS (56 samples, at 5.7-6.2 and 12.1-12.8 s), cut30 +1.5. Turning the score down does not fix it (score -6 dB still peaks +0.5 dBFS) and would change the balance. Fix it as the source does, on the master bus.
mix_rule.master: Sum lines + score in float (or at -4.4 dB) and run one peak limiter: ceiling -1.0 dBFS, attack 5 ms, release 50 ms, no makeup gain. ffmpeg: volume=1.6667,alimiter=limit=0.891:attack=5:release=50:level=false after a 0.6 pre-gain. Gain reduction is under 2.5 dB and only on those few peaks. Result: cut15 -17.8 LUFS, peak -1.0 dBFS; cut30 -18.1 LUFS.
mix_rule.effects: laser sizzle under the etch spark windows only: band-passed noise 3-8 kHz at -48 dBFS RMS, gated on while a spark is lit

product_name_fill.why: The source's product name is muted inside L14 (clip 0.30-0.80, 0.50 s) and L21 (clip 0.06-0.50, 0.44 s). Fill exactly that window with the new name in his voice.
product_name_fill.voice_sample: set/voice_founder_clean.wav: 15.68 s of the founder, cut from the music-free vocal stem (source 33.98-49.66: 'That's insane. Any country that can't build its own computers can't secure them. If you don't control your technology, you can't control your future. 80 years ago, America pioneered modern computing to defend our nation. Now, we're bringing it home.'). Noise floor -74 dBFS: no music under it (voice_founder.wav carries the score bed at about -23 dB, which a reference-mode render copies into its output).
product_name_fill.how: Reference mode: ref_audios = [set/voice_founder_clean.wav], refs = [set/char_founder_sheet.jpg]; prompt the two lines whole, e.g. <d>[English] This is {PRODUCT}.</d> ... <d>[English] {PRODUCT} is America's comeback.</d>, dry close-miked voice, silent room, no music. Cut the name at its word boundaries (zero crossings, 10 ms fades). It must fit the slot without speed change: L14 0.50 s, L21 0.44 s; if it is longer, re-render asking for a quicker, clipped delivery rather than time-stretching.
product_name_fill.level: Match the muted original: RMS -21.9 dBFS / peak -4.1 in L14, RMS -17.1 / peak -1.7 in L21 (the surrounding words in L14 run -23 dBFS RMS). Set the fill's RMS to that value, start it at the slot start (L14: 0.30 s into the clip), and leave the rest of each clip untouched.
